sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionCategory,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountedRevenue,
    avg(p.DiscountPercent) AS AvgDiscountPercent
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE f.DiscountAmount > 0
  AND p.PromotionCategory IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY TotalDiscountedRevenue DESC
